title: Labour faces double blow over UK fossil fuel projects
summary_full: Large North Sea operator EnQuest says it is quitting oil basin, while SSE threatens to close Yorkshire gas storage siteThe energy secretary has been dealt a double blow after two UK companies signalled plans to pull their investment from large fossil fuel projects amid disagreements over government policies.One of the North Sea’s biggest independent companies, EnQuest, said on Wednesday it was quitting the North Sea oil and gas basin to focus on making better returns in Asia, blaming the “uncertain investment environment within the UK”.
